inputs.body:
Hi,

Our water heater is 14 years old and the pilot keeps going out. We're in East Pennick, three bedrooms, family of four. I'd like a quote to replace it with a standard 40 gallon tank. Can you tell me roughly what that costs and how soon someone could come look?

Thanks,
Dana

Thanks,
